colour_palette.details: Uses generic Wix Thunderbolt default palette variables with stark black, white, and raw red. No custom retro-diner brand aesthetic.

logo.details: Embedded as a low-resolution raster JPEG on Wix CDN. The favicon is pixelated on mobile screens and Retina displays.

typography.details: Hardcoded to generic 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif' without typographic hierarchy or custom web fonts.

contact.details: Verified phone, direct Gmail contact, physical address on 'The Drag', and active community ownership under Mark Nemir.

online_presence.details: Wix Thunderbolt renderer with high JavaScript payload and slow First Contentful Paint. Basic SEO is missing rich Open Graph tags and Schema.org markup.

verdict.commercial_rationale: Operating since 1926 (approaching their 100-year centennial!). Incredible heritage and brand love with thousands of UT alumni and Austin locals, yet their website is a generic Wix site that does not reflect their iconic status.

sample_website.notes: Centennial-edition retro diner redesign celebrating 100 years of Austin history.
